## Summary

Adds the first current-main ADR 0156 campaign module as a small independently valid slice: authoritative seven-task harness mapping, task-specific frozen tool budgets, physical model representation identity, runtime/platform identity, candidate source metadata, and task execution identity. Physical GGUF bytes deliberately exclude runtime/platform identity so later Windows-native/WSL2 characterization remains distinct from model-only comparison.

Campaign plan/state, controlled fixtures, managed acquisition, worker execution, UI, and final validation continue on this Draft PR.
